version.changelog: fix: update OpenClaw SDK compatibility to 2026.6.10 and harden session recovery

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Chinese-language interface for a resilience monitoring plugin, with no evidence of hidden exfiltration or destructive behavior in the packaged artifacts.

dimensions.detail: The skill’s stated purpose is API error monitoring, retry strategy management, reporting, dashboard access, and session recovery; the listed tools and dashboard UI match that purpose, but the actual sensitive implementation is delegated to the separate @leiJack-lo/resilience plugin.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are explicit about dashboard opening, retry strategy updates, reports, and recovery prompt configuration; the natural-language dashboard triggers are somewhat broad but still related to the monitoring dashboard.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Installation requires a separate plugin installed with --dangerously-force-unsafe-install, plus gateway restart and an optional allowConversationAccess setting; these are high-impact steps, but they are clearly disclosed rather than hidden.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The described local HTTP dashboard, model-call hooks, agent-end hook, and local OpenClaw data directory are proportionate to error monitoring and recovery, and the bundled JavaScript uses same-origin dashboard API calls rather than external network destinations.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Persistent logs, stats, strategies, recovery settings, active retries, and task data are disclosed under ~/.openclaw/plugins/resilience/instances/<id>/; conversation access is described as gated by an explicit config setting.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable adding the separate resilience plugin with local hooks, a local dashboard server, and persistent OpenClaw monitoring data. Review the plugin itself before using the forced unsafe install flag, and enable conversation access only if you want session recovery features.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] expected: The broad dashboard-opening phrases are present, but they map to a user-visible local monitoring dashboard and are consistent with the skill’s purpose; this is a usability/intent-precision concern, not enough by itself for Review.
